versions.subject: net.exe and wmic.exe
versions.detection:
selection:
    EventID: 1
    Image:
        - '*\wmic.exe'
    CommandLine:
        - '*process call create*'
        - '*/NODE:*'
condition: selection
versions.spl: EventID=1 Image="*\\wmic.exe" CommandLine IN ("*process call create*", "*/NODE:*")

versions.subject: Improved WMIC process call create rule
versions.detection:
selection:
    EventID: 1
    Image:
        - '*\wmic.exe'
    CommandLine:
        - '*/NODE:*process call create *'
        - '* path AntiVirusProduct get *'
        - '* path FirewallProduct get *'
        - '* shadowcopy delete *'
condition: selection
versions.spl: EventID=1 Image="*\\wmic.exe" CommandLine IN ("*/NODE:*process call create *", "* path AntiVirusProduct get *", "* path FirewallProduct get *", "* shadowcopy delete *")
